blockingIssues.description: app/analytics.tsx hardcodes fake trend copy such as `12% vs last season`, `8%`, and `3%` instead of deriving those values from analytics data.

app/analytics.tsx builds the new `Activities Logged` stat and category breakdown from `analytics.recentActivity`, which is a truncated sample and omits categories like expenses/fertigation, so the redesigned counts are inaccurate.
app/analytics.tsx adds new labels without locale entries and also hardcodes English strings like `tons`, `entries`, and `vs last season`, regressing i18n.
app/logs.tsx renders selected category filter chips in per-category colors instead of the required primary-background active state, so VAL-LOGS-002 is unmet.
app/tasks.tsx moves completed tasks into a separate Completed tab instead of an in-screen collapsible completed section, so VAL-TASKS-003 is not implemented.
src/components/cards/task-row.tsx dims completed cards to 0.6 opacity instead of the required 0.8 opacity.

src/components/screens/attendance-subcomponents/mark-attendance-tab.tsx still renders a single-worker date-range grid instead of worker rows with Full/Half/Absent pill toggles, so VAL-ATTEND-001 is not implemented.
src/components/screens/attendance-subcomponents/mark-attendance-tab.tsx uses From/To date pickers rather than the required arrow-based date navigator, so VAL-ATTEND-002 is unmet.
src/components/screens/attendance-subcomponents/mark-attendance-tab.tsx shows a conditional Save button instead of an always-visible `Mark All Present` sticky CTA, so VAL-ATTEND-003 is unmet.
app/lab-tests.tsx uses `colors.surface[500]` for inactive Soil/Petiole tab text instead of the required stone-5 muted color (#A89E92), so VAL-LABTESTS-002 is still failing.
app/spray-catalog.tsx hardcodes every chemical badge to `Fungicide`, so the redesign misrepresents catalog data.
app/spray-catalog.tsx treats any positive `phi_days` value as an active PHI warning even though `phi_days` is static catalog metadata, not runtime active-window state.
app/spray-catalog.tsx only keeps `mix.components.slice(1)` tappable, so the first component no longer opens `ProductDetailSheet`.

appliedUpdates.description: Added `.factory/library/spray-catalog-data-model.md` documenting that `src/types/phi.ts` does not expose chemical classification, usage-history, or live PHI-active flags, and that `phi_days` is static catalog metadata.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add an explicit rule for visual redesign tasks: do not invent metrics, classifications, or warning states when the current data model does not provide them. Preserve truthful data, or document the gap for follow-up instead of hardcoding placeholders.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Two blocking failures in this round came from invented semantics: `analytics-redesign` hardcoded fake trend values and derived category totals from a truncated sample, while `spray-catalog-redesign` hardcoded all badges to Fungicide and treated `phi_days > 0` as a live PHI warning even though the data model has no such state.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Require workers to record the exact AGENTS/architecture/wireframe files consulted in the handoff or transcript evidence, so scrutiny can verify the mandated startup reads instead of relying on `skillFeedback.followedProcedure` alone.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Multiple review reports (`analytics-redesign`, `logs-redesign`, `workers-and-attendance-redesign`, and `lab-tests-and-soil-redesign`) found `handoff.skillFeedback.followedProcedure=true` even though the transcript skeleton did not show the required reads of AGENTS.md, architecture.md, or the light/dark wireframes.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add a crash-recovery convention for orchestrator-completed features: when a worker crashes and the orchestrator finishes the feature, write a synthetic handoff that records the final commit and any missing transcript context.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: For `tasks-redesign`, `features.json` left `completedWorkerSessionId` null and there was no matching handoff/transcript skeleton, so scrutiny had to infer the reviewed commit from git history before it could audit the feature.

rejectedObservations.observation: Repeated reports that `ui-worker` startup reads were not evidenced in the transcript skeleton for individual features.
rejectedObservations.reason: duplicate; consolidated into one systemic `skill:ui-worker` recommendation backed by analytics, logs, workers, and lab-tests reviews.
